quiz_facts.prompt: What is the name of Gandalf's horse?
Where was the One Ring destroyed?

entries.name: The One Ring
entries.description: A powerful ring forged by Sauron to dominate the other Rings of Power.

entries.name: Sauron
entries.description: The Dark Lord who forged the One Ring to dominate Middle-earth.

entries.name: Frodo Baggins
entries.description: A Hobbit tasked with bringing the One Ring to Mount Doom in Mordor to be destroyed.

entries.name: Samwise Gamgee
entries.description: Frodo’s loyal friend who travels with him toward Mordor and supports him throughout the quest.

entries.name: Legolas
entries.faction: Elves of Mirkwood / Fellowship of the Ring
entries.description: An Elven prince and skilled archer who joins the Fellowship.

entries.name: Gandalf
entries.description: A wizard who helps unite the Free Peoples against Sauron.

entries.name: Shadowfax
entries.description: The famous horse ridden by Gandalf, known as the lord of horses.

entries.name: Aragorn
entries.faction: Dúnedain / Fellowship of the Ring / Gondor
entries.description: A Ranger of the North who becomes king and wields a reforged blade.

entries.name: Andúril
entries.description: Aragorn’s sword that was reforged from the shards of Narsil.

entries.name: Gollum
entries.description: A corrupted creature obsessed with the One Ring, often calling it 'My precious'.

entries.name: Mount Doom
entries.description: The volcano in Mordor where the One Ring can be destroyed.

entries.name: The Shire
entries.description: A peaceful region in the northwest of Middle-earth; homeland of the Hobbits.

entries.name: Orthanc
entries.description: A tower in Isengard where Saruman imprisons Gandalf before his escape.

entries.name: Great Eagles
entries.description: Giant eagles that occasionally aid the Free Peoples; they help Gandalf escape from Orthanc.

entries.name: Saruman
entries.description: A wizard who betrays the White Council and seeks power for himself.

entries.name: Fellowship of the Ring
entries.description: A group formed to help carry the One Ring to Mordor and destroy it.

entries.name: Rohan
entries.description: A kingdom of Men known for its horses and riders; capital is Edoras.

entries.name: Mordor
entries.description: The dark realm of Sauron where Mount Doom lies.
